questions.question: Which Indian state launched the first Tribal Genome Sequencing Project?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Gujarat launches India’s first tribal genome project to tackle inherited diseases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
Gujarat is the first Indian state to launch a Tribal Genome Sequencing Project.

 
 
• 
 
The goal is to enhance healthcare for tribal communities using genetic research.

 
 
• 
 
It targets early detection of hereditary diseases like sickle cell anaemia and thalassemia.

 
 
• 
 
The Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre (GBRC) is leading the project.

 
 
• 
 
2,000 tribal individuals will have their genomes sequenced.

 
 
• 
 
The data will be used to build a reference genome database.

 
 
• 
 
This initiative supports the development of personalised medicine.

 
 
• 
 
It will also enable more effective, targeted treatments for tribal populations.

questions.question: Which two institutions have entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to integrate science and innovation into sports performance in India?

questions.question: Which new Harappan site has been discovered in Rajasthan?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Ratadiya Ri Dheri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• 4500-year-old Harappan civilisation remains discovered near Pak border in Rajasthan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
A **Harappan site** has been discovered at **Ratadiya Ri Dheri** in **Jaisalmer**, Rajasthan.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **first known Indus Valley settlement** in the **Jaisalmer district**.

 
 
• 
 
The site is located **17 km northwest** of **Sadewala** in **Pakistan**, where Harappan traces were earlier found.

 
 
• 
 
This discovery **bridges the archaeological gap** between **northern Rajasthan** and **Gujarat**.

 
 
• 
 
Previously, **Pilibanga** was the most prominent Harappan site in Rajasthan.

 
 
• 
 
Pilibanga was studied by **Luigi Pio Tessitori**, an Italian Indologist, and excavated in the **1960s**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Harappan civilization** is among the **oldest civilizations**, along with **Egypt** and **Mesopotamia**.

 
 
• 
 
It developed along the **Indus River**, hence also known as the **Indus Valley Civilization**.

 
 
• 
 
It is classified as a **Bronze Age civilization**, known for using **copper-based alloys**.

questions.question: Which country has recently banned 26 major social media platforms, including Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, WhatsApp, and Snapchat, for failing to register with the government?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Nepal has ordered ISPs to block 26 major social media and communication platforms, including Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, X, WhatsApp, and LinkedIn.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The ban was enforced after platforms failed to register with the government within the seven-day deadline.**
 
• **The move follows a Supreme Court directive to regulate online platforms and monitor unwanted content.**
 
• **The government’s directive requires platforms to register, appoint a compliance officer, and set up complaint mechanisms.**
 
• **Some platforms like TikTok, Viber, and Telegram remain operational as they complied or are in process of registering.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Directive on Regulating the Use of Social Media, 2080__

 __
 
• Mandates registration of both domestic and foreign social media platforms.
 
• Requires a local contact person and compliance officer in Nepal.
 
• Ensures mechanisms to address local complaints about online content.
 
 
 
• Criticism__
 
 
• Rights groups view the ban as censorship and a threat to freedom of expression.
 
• Concerns raised over a proposed social media bill that could impose fines or jail for content against "national interest".

questions.question: India has nominated the ancient Buddhist site Sarnath for UNESCO World Heritage Status 2025. In which Indian state is Sarnath located?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India Nominates Sarnath for UNESCO World Heritage Status 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
India submitted a dossier for **“Ancient Buddhist Site, Sarnath”** to **UNESCO** for the **2025–26 nomination cycle**.

 
 
• 
 
**Sarnath**, located near **Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh**, is where **Gautama Buddha** delivered his **first sermon** – the **Dhammachakkappavattana Sutta**.

 
 
• 
 
Marks the **beginning of the Buddhist Sangha** (monastic community).

 
 
• 
 
One of the **four most sacred Buddhist pilgrimage sites**, along with **Bodh Gaya**, **Lumbini**, and **Kushinagar**.

 
 
• 
 
Was a major **centre of Buddhist learning** and **cultural exchange** on ancient pilgrimage routes.

 
 
• 
 
Reflects **Mauryan**, **Kushan**, and **Gupta architectural styles**.

 
 
• 
 
**Dhamek Stupa** (built in 500 CE) commemorates Buddha’s first sermon.

 
 
• 
 
**Ashokan Pillar**, originally topped with the **Lion Capital** (now India’s **national emblem**).

 
 
• 
 
**Chaukhandi Stupa** marks the site where Buddha met his **first disciples**.

 
 
• 
 
**Mulagandha Kuti Vihar**, a modern temple with **Buddha frescoes**, built by the **Mahabodhi Society**.

 
 
• 
 
**Sarnath Archaeological Museum** preserves key artefacts including the **original Lion Capital**.

questions.question: In the 56th GST Council meeting (September 2025), a new 40% GST slab was introduced. Which of the following goods and services fall under this highest tax category?

options.text: Pan masala, luxury cars beyond small-car limits, online gaming
Small petrol cars, motorcycles up to 350cc, sewing machines
Diagnostic kits, life-saving drugs, corrective spectacles

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pan masala, luxury cars beyond small-car limits, online gaming.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 56th GST Council meeting introduced a new 40% GST slab for sin and luxury goods to balance revenue losses from reduced rates on essentials.**
 
• **This steep slab covers harmful products, luxury items, and activities such as betting and gambling, ensuring higher revenue collection.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **40% GST slab introduced for sin and luxury goods.**
 
• **Products covered include pan masala, gutkha, cigarettes, bidis, luxury cars beyond small-car limits, motorcycles above 350cc, yachts, and personal-use aircraft.**
 
• **Also applicable to online gaming, casinos, betting, gambling, and licensing of bookmakers.**
 
• **This ensures harmful and luxury consumption remains a major source of government revenue without burdening essentials.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Goods under 5% slab**__

 __
 
• Daily essentials: hair oil, shampoo, toothpaste, soaps, dairy products, snacks, tractors, pesticides, and irrigation equipment.
 
 
 
• **Goods under 18% slab**__
 __
 
• Consumer durables and automobiles: ACs, TVs, washing machines, small cars, motorcycles up to 350cc, and commercial vehicles.
 
 
 
• **Healthcare Relief**__
 __
 
• Life and health insurance premiums exempted.
 
• 33 life-saving drugs made GST-free, diagnostic kits and corrective spectacles at 5%.
 
 
 
• **Revenue Balance**__
 
 
• Higher taxes on sin and luxury goods offset revenue losses from cuts on essentials, keeping fiscal stability intact.

questions.question: Which city ranked as the most liveable in the Global Liveability Index 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Copenhagen**__.

The **Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU)** released the **Global Liveability Index 2025**, ranking **173 cities**.

 
 
• 
 
The index evaluates cities on **30 indicators** across **five categories**:

 
 
• 
 
**Stability**

 
 
• 
 
**Healthcare**

 
 
• 
 
**Culture & Environment**

 
 
• 
 
**Education**

 
 
• 
 
**Infrastructure**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Cities are scored from **1 (worst)** to **100 (best)**.

 
 
• 
 
**Copenhagen (Denmark)** is the **most liveable city** in 2025 (score: **98/100**).

 
 
• 
 
**Zurich (Switzerland)** and **Vienna (Austria)** tied for **2nd place** (97.1/100).

 
 
• 
 
**Copenhagen** achieved **perfect scores** in **stability, education, and infrastructure**, ending Vienna’s 3-year streak at the top.

 
 
• 
 
**Least liveable cities**:

 
 
• 
 
**Damascus (Syria)** – 30.7/100

 
 
• 
 
**Tripoli (Libya)** – 40.1/100

 
 
• 
 
**Dhaka (Bangladesh)** – 41.7/100

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**India’s performance**:

 
 
• 
 
**Delhi** and **Mumbai** both scored **60.2**, ranked **141st** out of 173.

• Mamata Banerjee Launches Shramshree Scheme for Migrant Workers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Shramshree Scheme** launched by **West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee**.

 
 
• 
 
Offers **₹5,000 monthly aid** for up to **one year** or until a new job is found.

 
 
• 
 
Aimed at supporting **Bengali migrant workers** facing **linguistic discrimination** in other states.

 
 
• 
 
Provides **financial support**, **job cards**, and **skill training**.

 
 
• 
 
Focus on **self-employment** and **entrepreneurship development**.

 
 
• 
 
Workers must return to **West Bengal** and have a **valid bank account**.
